CustomField.description: Formula to mark if Stage has gone backward. Uses Previous Stage Field which is filled in via WF.
CustomField.formula: CASE( StageName , "Prospecting",1, "Meeting Held - Interested",2, "Awaiting RFP",3, "Active RFP",4, "Building Support From Stakeholders",5, "Verbal Selection",6, "Legal",7, "Client Signed",8, "Closed Won",9, "Closed Lost",9,0) < CASE( Previous_Stage__c , "Prospecting",1, "Meeting Held - Interested",2, "Awaiting RFP",3, "Active RFP",4, "Building Support From Stakeholders",5, "Verbal Selection",6, "Legal",7, "Client Signed",8, "Closed Won",9, "Closed Lost",9,0)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Formula to mark if Stage has gone backward. Uses Previous Stage Field which is filled in via WF.
CustomField.label: Stage Regressed
